In detail

Bologna's western edge, residential and industrial, well away from anything a visitor comes for — the Ducati works and the airport approach are here. Local reporting on the quartiere identifies Barca and Casteldebole, the parts with the weakest socio-economic profile, as more exposed to drug dealing; the rest is unremarkable suburb. Few travellers stay here and there is little reason to walk it at night.
